raw_response:
I have farmed this land in SNNP for many years without formal schooling, and for this small 0.05 hectare perennial plot I do not buy chemical fertilizer because it is too costly for such a small area, though I do spread cow manure and compost from around my homestead to feed the plants. I plant the same local varieties my family has always used, and I do not spray pesticides or irrigate because water is scarce and chemicals are expensive. My family will spend about fifteen days weeding and tending this plot over the season, but it is too small to need hired workers.
